description: This file contains a shell script defining the 'preinit_set_mac_address' function, which sets MAC addresses on various network interfaces based on the specific hardware identified by 'board_name'. It includes several external script dependencies and references functions for hardware-specific MAC address retrieval.

methods.name: preinit_set_mac_address
methods.description: Defines hardware-specific logic to set MAC addresses on various network interfaces during system pre-initialization.
